description: Plantage Kerklaan 24-32 (BAG 1873-1879): 5.0 m dark brick fronts of a 5 m shop storey and four upper storeys under a neck gable; three axes of white-framed round-arched windows (the middle axis square-headed on storeys 1-2), iron balcony rails on the middle axis, a small attic light in the gable, white string courses; residential door beside the shop

match.note: Kerklaan 24-32: the 3DBAG eaves scatter 15.4-18.5 on one design (photo cornice 17.0 m); keyed by the face pin

neck-gable.note: neck gable above the 17.0 m cornice, apex about 18.2 m, flat coping

door-left.note: door on the left axis beside the shop

schemaLimits: the sculpted keystone heads of 44 are plain blocks
the dormer's low side cheeks are not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-10 gridded 80 px/m: shop to 5.0 m; storey windows 5.5-8.0, 8.6-11.0, 11.75-14.4; gable light 15.3-16.6 below the 17.0 m cornice; gable apex 18.2 m; 5.0 m fronts

schemaLimits: the gable light sits inside the front wall below the cornice (a fifth storey light) and the gable above is plain
balcony rails on the middle axis are not drawn
